summary: Elevate your career with our Mining Environmental Management Training. Learn to implement sustainable practices and ensure compliance in the mining sector.
lede: Mining environmental management covers assessing and reducing environmental risks across the life of an extraction project. For mine environmental and sustainability professionals, the course develops skills in environmental and social impact assessment, site water balance planning, and acid mine drainage mitigation. It also addresses progressive rehabilitation and mine closure planning.
audienceIntro: This program is structured for professionals responsible for ecological compliance, risk mitigation, and sustainability reporting within the extraction sector.
modules: Environmental Impact Assessment and Baseline Monitoring
Geochemistry and Acid Mine Drainage Mitigation
Air Quality, Noise, and Biodiversity Conservation
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of mining operations or environmental science. Familiarity with basic regulatory compliance concepts is recommended. No advanced geochemical modeling or coding experience is required.
